issues.title: Users may be unable to connect to multiple Microsoft 365 services
issues.impact: Users may have been unable to connect to multiple Microsoft 365 services.
issues.current: This was a technical issue not related to cyber or AI / agents. The incident was introduced by an issue during an earlier network capacity upgrade that surfaced following a recent network change. We have addressed the underlying issue and continue to restore service to remaining customers and regions. Given the scale of demand, we restored services gradually, validating stability at each stage. While this took longer, it helped ensure a stable restoration. We will provide a full post-incident report once our review is complete.
issues.scope: This issue may have affected users attempting to access the affected Microsoft 365 services.

affected.t: Users may be unable to access their mailbox using Outlook on the web, Outlook desktop (MAPI), Exchange ActiveSync (EAS), or REST-based connections, and email delivery may be delayed.
Admins may be unable to load some admin center pages.
Users may be unable to view their recently used files.
Multiple services including Cloud Update, Cloud Policy, and Inventory are affected.
Features including Assignments, Reading Progress, and Speaker Progress may be impacted.
Users may be unable to load Copilot Chat or receive responses in the web and desktop apps, and Copilot experiences may be unable to access work data such as email, calendar, and files.

Some Defender for Office 365 experiences that rely on Purview DLP/Information Protection signals may experience delays or failures in policy evaluation and governance action enforcement. Some users may experience issues when sharing SharePoint Online files with people outside their organization, where external sharing is permitted by both organization-level and site-level settings. Additionally, features that depend on Exchange Online may be impacted. Accessing files stored directly in SharePoint Onli…

issues.title: Admins may see Windows and Android devices appear as unmonitored in the Pro Management Portal (PMP) in Microsoft Teams
issues.impact: Admins may see Windows and Android devices appear as unmonitored in the PMP in Microsoft Teams.
issues.current: We anticipate that our fixes will be fully saturated, automatically restoring devices to a healthy state, by our next scheduled update. However, we've confirmed that admins who wish to receive the fix faster can initiate a restart or bulk restart of affected devices through the Teams Admin Center to remediate this event immediately.
issues.scope: This event may impact any admin attempting to manage Windows and Android devices through the Microsoft Teams Pro Management Portal. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

issues.title: Some users may not see free/busy info shared between organizations using cross-tenant access policy in Exchange Online
issues.impact: Users may not see free/busy info shared between organizations using cross-tenant access policy in Exchange Online.
issues.current: The deployment of our fix was paused while we addressed a separate issue and remains at 62 percent saturation to the affected environment. We've finished addressing the unrelated issue, and we've resumed the deployment of our fix. Due to this delay, we now anticipate the fix will complete deployment by Monday, November 16, 2026.
issues.scope: This issue impacts some users whose organization utilizes cross-tenant access policy, who may be unable to view free/busy info shared between organizations in Exchange Online. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

issues.title: Users were unable to view reporting metrics for Amplify Campaigns in SharePoint Online
issues.impact: Users were unable to view reporting metrics for Amplify Campaigns in SharePoint Online.
issues.current: We've confirmed through extended monitoring that the fix successfully returned the service to expected performance levels and restored the affected infrastructure. We'll continue monitoring service telemetry to validate that the service remains healthy and impact doesn't reoccur.
issues.scope: Impact was specific to users attempting to view reporting metrics for Amplify Campaigns in SharePoint Online.

issues.title: Users may be unable to view contacts and Speed Dial entries in Microsoft Teams, Outlook desktop and mobile
issues.impact: Users may be unable to view contacts and Speed Dial entries in Microsoft Teams, Outlook desktop and mobile.
issues.current: We’re proceeding to deploy a code fix to repair the remaining affected contacts on a user basis. The deployment is due to complete by Friday, November 20, 2026, and we’re continuing to monitor as the rollout progresses.
issues.scope: Some users attempting to view contacts and Speed Dial entries in Microsoft Teams, Outlook desktop and mobile may be impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

issues.title: Some users may be unable to upload audio files using the Transcribe feature in Word for the web using some browsers
issues.impact: Users may have been unable to upload audio files using the Transcribe feature in Word for the web using some browsers.
issues.current: We've confirmed through our service health telemetry that our code fix has fully deployed to all affected environments. Please reach out to Microsoft support if impact persist.
issues.scope: Some users who attempted to upload audio files for transcription using the Transcribe feature in Word for the web on Chromium-based browsers may have been impacted if their browser window's size was under the minimum threshold.

issues.impact: Agents were unable to access Dynamics 365 Contact Center. Final Status: We have completed the restart. Following a period of monitoring service diagnostics, we have confirmed that agent access to Dynamics 365 Contact Center has been restored. A Post Incident Report will be published within five days. Preliminary Root Cause: A portion of the database infrastructure responsible for Contact Center e…

issues.title: Users may experience delays installing Volume Purchase Program (VPP) apps in Microsoft Intune for iOS and Mac
issues.impact: Users may have experienced delays installing VPP apps in Microsoft Intune for iOS and Mac.
issues.current: The third-party provided have deployed their fix, and we've confirmed through monitoring service health telemetry that the impact has been remediated.
issues.scope: This event may have impacted any user installing VPP apps in Microsoft Intune for iOS and Mac.

issues.title: Users may have been unable to utilize the Side Pane in Microsoft Word and received an error message
issues.impact: Users may have been unable to utilize the Side Pane in Microsoft Word and received an error message.
issues.current: We've determined that a recent change to the underlying service infrastructure affected its ability to process requests successfully. We've rebalanced resources across the affected infrastructure and after a period of monitoring, confirmed that impact has been remediated.
issues.scope: Some users attempting to utilize the Side Pane in Microsoft Word may have been impacted by this event.

issues.title: Some users may be unable to load chat history or previously pinned chats, and can't pin chats in Microsoft 365 Copilot
issues.current: A post-incident report has been published.

issues.title: Admins may encounter delays in accessing audit log data results in Microsoft Purview Audit
issues.impact: Admins may encounter delays in accessing audit log data results in Microsoft Purview Audit.
issues.current: The processing of the aforementioned backlog is steadily progressing and users should see relief as it continues to progress. We'll continue to monitor it to ensure it successfully completes and issue is resolved.
issues.scope: Any admin attempting to access audit log data from Microsoft Purview Audit may be affected. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

issues.title: Some users may see delays receiving policies, apps, and other changes on Windows devices enrolled in Microsoft Intune
issues.impact: Users may see delays receiving policies, apps, and other changes on Windows devices enrolled in Microsoft Intune.
issues.current: We’ve confirmed that a recent Windows security update, MSRC144654, can cause a single check in to fail during installation. We’re developing a fix to address this issue and anticipate its release for early December 2026. We’ll provide a better estimate for the delivery of our fix when available.
issues.scope: Some users with Windows devices enrolled in Microsoft Intune may experience delays receiving policies, apps, and other changes while their devices install Windows security update MSRC144654. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

issues.title: Users may be unable to view recent portions of their conversation history with Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
issues.current: A post-incident report has been published.

issues.title: Some users’ email messages may not be quarantined and fail to be stored in the quarantine folder
issues.current: A post-incident report has been published.

issues.title: Some users may intermittently receive no response when submitting queries in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
issues.impact: Users may have intermittently received no response when submitting queries in Copilot Chat.
issues.current: While we were in the process of analyzing the "499" error codes in the request flow, system monitoring indicated that the service had returned to normal health. We've confirmed that the issue is no longer occurring and we'll continue to monitor the service to ensure that the problem doesn't happen again.
issues.scope: Some users located in West Europe that attempted to submit queries to Copilot Chat were affected.

issues.title: Users may receive duplicate email messages sent to mailboxes using Exchange Online SMTP forwarding
issues.impact: Users may have received duplicate email messages sent to mailboxes using Exchange Online SMTP forwarding.
issues.current: We've validated that our deployed fix finished saturating throughout the affected environment and has successfully remediated all impact for this issue.
issues.scope: Any user expecting email messages in an Exchange Online mailbox configured with SMTP forwarding may have been impacted by this event.

issues.title: Some users may have encountered intermittent failures or delays when managing Microsoft Teams channels
issues.impact: Users may have encountered intermittent failures or delays when managing Microsoft Teams channels.
issues.current: We've determined that higher request volumes had placed additional load on the affected service infrastructure, resulting in intermittent failures and delays. We've restarted affected services to improve service availability and after monitoring service health confirmed impact has been mitigated.
issues.scope: Impact was specific to some users in Europe attempting to manage Microsoft Teams channels.

issues.title: Admins may not be receiving new Microsoft Copilot low latency adoption reports from the Microsoft 365 admin center
issues.impact: Admins may not have received new Microsoft Copilot low latency adoption reports from the Microsoft 365 admin center.
issues.current: We’ve completed deployment of the fix and confirmed through service telemetry that the issue is resolved.
issues.scope: Any admin expecting to receive new Microsoft Copilot low latency adoption reports for November 9, 2026, or later may have been affected.

issues.title: Users' Microsoft Teams contact cards may not fully display Out of office text
issues.impact: Users' Microsoft Teams contact cards may not have fully displayed Out of office text.
issues.current: Following the deployment of our solution, our internal service telemetry has verified that contact cards are displaying the full expected Out of office text, and that the impact has been remediated.
issues.scope: Any user attempting to view Out of office text on Microsoft Teams contact cards may have been impacted.

issues.title: Users may be unable to view previously deleted teams after restoration in Microsoft Teams
issues.impact: Users may have been unable to view previously deleted teams after restoration in Microsoft Teams.
issues.current: We've confirmed that the fix has completed across all affected environments and validated this issue has been remediated with service telemetry and affected users.
issues.scope: This issue may have affected any user attempting to view previously deleted and restored teams.

issues.title: Users' Microsoft 365 Apps usage reports may show outdated data in the Microsoft 365 admin center
issues.impact: Users' Microsoft 365 Apps usage reports may have shown outdated data in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
issues.current: We've completed processing the backlog of events and validated that Microsoft 365 apps usage reports are now up to date.
issues.scope: This issue may have impacted any admin who is attempting to view Microsoft 365 Apps usage reports in the admin center.

issues.title: Some users may be intermittently unable to send email messages to Outlook.com, Hotmail.com, or Live.com email addresses
issues.impact: Users may have been unable to send email messages to Outlook.com, Hotmail.com, or Live.com email addresses.
issues.current: We've investigated the provided logs and our service health telemetry, and identified a recent update to the spam enforcement rules caused email messages to be incorrectly marked and blocked, which led to impact. We've fully rolled back this update and confirmed that mail flow has been restored and impact is resolved.
issues.scope: Some users may have intermittently been unable to send email messages to Outlook, Hotmail, and Live email accounts.
